name: lightcone-experimental
description: Opt-in, experimental skills for advanced Lightcone workflows — under active development, expect rough edges. Paper reproduction (`lc-from-paper`), code import (`lc-from-code`), literature substrate extraction (`paper-extraction`), autonomous iteration (`ralph`), and manuscript verification (`check-sentence-by-sentence`, `figure-comparison`). Depends on the core lightcone plugin. Install when you need capabilities beyond the core analysis workflow.
